title: lock.acquire raises TimeoutError when retrying a failed job
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.0.7; operating system Windows Server 2022; server region us-east-1.

Steps

Steps to reproduce:
- With the log window open, start retrying a failed job.
- Switch the network profile to the slow network preset before starting.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

Expected

As on every earlier run, retrying a failed job should just complete.

Actual

After exactly thirty seconds the operation aborted and printed the traceback. We are on a slow
network here; one slow reply and the whole job dies instead of retrying.

Frequency

It occurs twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:45 in loop
lattice/sched/runner.py:128 in run_due
lattice/sched/queue.py:81 in drain
lattice/sched/lock.py:166 in acquire
TimeoutError: lock not acquired within 30s
